app_state: Account-scoped IndexedDB audio drafts and itinerary snapshot; never canonical business records. No bearer tokens persisted. Offline reload requires the last authenticated tab binding, which successful sign-out revokes. Online resumption revalidates identity. Capture-only: no upload or filing transport.
layout: Awaiting W1b shared sidebar/tab slot API. Tour day contains no page-level navigation or tab markup; existing app shell is the temporary shared host.

producer_requirements.submitNote: Authenticated versioned audio upload, exact note/tour/client/property/route/stop IDs, captured_at, supported MIME; note ID is immutable idempotency key. Server derives tenant, author and client binding from the tour. Bounded audio limits, consent policy, server audio digest and retention policy required.
producer_requirements.lookupNote: Authenticated authoritative absent/processing/filed result for exact immutable note ID; unknown outcome must be read before resend.
producer_requirements.filing: CARR transcribes and summarizes once, preserves original audio/transcript and atomically links one note to tour feedback and client activity. The application must not infer filed from an upload acknowledgement.
producer_requirements.activation: Implement, review, deploy and pin an exact producer revision plus versioned HTTP contract before enabling the live adapter. Test real phone microphone, background/lock behavior, encrypted offline storage policy and native navigation before promotion.

subject_read_producer.activation: Pending review, merge and deployment; consumer refuses unbound tours. This pin adds no audio write capability.
